text.9faf5c0a5fdd38051c23: H1 $4.395bn is NET advance movement, not gross receipts. At least $154.3m of opening advances was recognized; current-period advance recognition/FX are not fully isolated. Therefore >$9bn annual gross receipts cannot be reduced by $4.395bn to obtain exact H2 cash. Ranges are explicitly analytical. No extra value is assigned to customer advances.
text.0386cdaaa9d050e4cc96: Analytical conditional capital/financing path, not issuer guidance, consensus or promised funding. Same revenue path; owned-build stress lowers early EBIT to avoid impossible EBITDA.
text.327cf0bd8cd450556058: fcff No New Advances After Existing Advance Runoff
text.18b09841b08c472ace33: $20bn gross capex annually in 2027–2029; requires robust advances and roughly 50–55% adjusted EBITDA at assumed 3% SBC to preserve the inherited EBIT path. Forward spend, commissioning and unit prices must support this.
text.9af5e9b6f7d2316900a8: $14bn annual 2027–2029 capex is an efficiency / third-party-funded / paced-build alternative. It cannot simultaneously assume that Nebius wholly funds every >1GW/year deployment and keeps all gross infrastructure revenue. Partner economics and principal-agent revenue policy must be verified.
text.056b095abdf2a86ca795: $28bn/$26bn/$24bn early cash capex and higher D&A; early margin reset so adjusted EBITDA does not exceed 50% merely to preserve a valuation. More capital does not guarantee the inherited sales path.
text.8835c1bfcc4859720423: Early new advances assumed 20–40% of cash capex. This is an assumption, not 70% deal-count times 50–60% capex; deal-size weighting is undisclosed. Model recognition and eventual advance runoff.
text.35fb36b4141f71865feb: Other WC 3% of incremental revenue; D&A 30% of revenue after 2029. Advances normalize to 25% of annual sales by 2034 and remain stable in 2035–2036 and perpetuity. Explicit years bear every normalization cash use. Before-advance investment coefficient converges to 1.403125, leaving 1.153125 after normal advance growth; the (1+g) factor aligns current-year revenue increments with forward-funded NOPAT*g/ROIC. Final 2036 reinvestment is exactly NOPAT2036*g/ROIC; 2037 FCFF grows exactly 2.5%, with no exceptional terminal adjustment or extra transition years.
text.708e7bb1b7e0ab649423: Rent and power remain operating costs in EBIT. Do not also subtract their undiscounted sums as debt. New deposits/prepaid rents affect WC; amortization/lease-expense versus cash differences require an annual cash bridge.
text.62057153a079764482d7: The uncommenced lease division by 12 is a scale illustration only, not a payment schedule. Leases have differing commencement dates and terms; full-year cash costs may be materially higher/lower. Avoid duplicated power included in rent.
text.f43d6f78fadeb1173ba1: At 3-year GPU economic life rather than 5-year accounting life, hardware annual replacement/depreciation need rises by 13.333% of in-service hardware cost, before technology price changes and salvage. Existing margins must be adjusted together with D&A, not net capex alone.
text.89c7bad4e44d2f3d8bef: FY2026 $20–25bn spending precedes 2027 revenue and cannot be omitted from an October valuation/funding bridge.
text.b1654fbcec7d4f902a68: >1GW/year deployment is an operational aspiration; an owned-versus-partner split, equipment cost/MW and active utilization schedule are needed for the chosen pathway.
text.99e6cc133f6cb3a37b07: Advance refunds and late-delivery penalties can cause a liquidity shock while contracted revenue remains unrecognized.
text.52ea91fe1c007b9261e0: Undrawn authorization, private-stake carrying values, collateralized proceeds and restricted cash are not interchangeable with unrestricted funding.
text.4ddf5c58a391250501fa: Default to current actual debt/option/dilution claims, not projected deficits as present debt.

text.0117a9a90fe6ab083f69: All customer-advance normalization cash effects remain in 2030–2034 explicit FCFF. 2035–2036 balances and 2037 perpetuity follow 25% of revenue. Retained advances are matched performance obligations; no separate cash addback or debt deduction.
text.6a8e91da12b3a93932a3: Selected analytical central owned-build alternative for conditional operating valuation; funding and new customer advances are scenario assumptions.
text.09300752da4c68082e40: Midpoint of management full-year revenue guidance, not TTM reported revenue or ARR.
text.af988df1e679bcbba5dc: Use explicit gross capital cash spending - D&A + core WC - net customer advance increase. Do not also apply legacy delta-sales/S:C or add forecast deficits as debt. Revenue, WACC, tax, target margin and terminal ROIC otherwise preserved.
text.6eb832ae273246180b20: At year 2029 use explicitly accumulated balance. For years 2030 through maturity-year minus two, linearly fade advance/revenue ratio to 0.25; hold at 0.25 thereafter. For general allowed horizon N starting in 2027: fade = min(1,(forecastYearIndex-3)/(N-5)), where forecastYearIndex is 1-based and greater than 3. Thus N=10 completion is forecast year 8 = 2034.
text.93685afb246b3b7a7af5: advanceBalance_t - advanceBalance_(t-1); include in FCFF exactly once. Balance does not run off to zero. Do not add a separate terminal cash adjustment.
text.5a7193ae87e5f8c070fc: Forward-funded: final-year net investment after advances = NOPAT_final * g / terminalROIC. The smooth gross-capital path approaches a before-advance coefficient [(1+g)/impliedTerminalSalesToCapital + 0.25] times current revenue change, not [1/impliedTerminalSalesToCapital + 0.25].
text.b8633350cfc97b915efa: terminalFCFF/(WACC-g), measured at end of final explicit year
text.4e4ef77f7bdc98dd3d30: Sum explicit FCFF_t / cumulativeDiscountFactor_t, plus terminalValue / cumulativeDiscountFactor_final. At the FY2026 anchor, cumulativeDiscountFactor_final=(1+WACC)^10. For October17 valuation use the same additional FY2026 stub discount interval as explicit FCFF; do not discount terminal from an inconsistent date.
text.2fbae0f612de555d5b63: All normalized advance reductions are charged in explicit years; stable advance growth is subtracted from gross capex/WC investment to deliver the stated net NOPAT*g/ROIC, never added a second time.
